`final class FieldSelection`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.control.field` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [FieldSelection.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/control/field/FieldSelection.java)

A range of characters of a field, from a start index to an end index.

## Description

The start is never after the end; an empty range has the start equal to the end.

## Learn more

- [Text fields](/use/learn/interactivity/text-fields/#give-and-take-the-focus)
